findings.why: Cell prints '1 Br/ 1 Bth/ 2 1/2 Bth' on two lines. '2 1/2 Bth' reads as 2.5, but the extra '1 Bth' makes it unclear: it could mean 1 full bath plus two half baths. 1.5 is not printed anywhere.

read_problems: Unit 1 beds/baths printed as "1 Br/ 1 Bth/ 2 1/2 Bth" - interpreted baths as 1.5 (1 Bth + 1/2 Bth); unclear if "2 1/2" refers to a second separate bath count rather than a half bath addition.

ext_sf column contains combined yard/terrace and storage figures (e.g. "1,035 Y & 283 S") which includes storage area, not purely terrace/yard; reported as printed since only one combined figure exists per unit.
